why_best: This deliberate, real-time buildup establishes immediate credibility with technical audiences by grounding the narrative in the familiar cadence of actual work.
why_bad: A flashy, instant reveal of pre-rendered graphics would feel superficial and lose the authentic sense of craftsmanship this audience respects.
trap: A close failure would be letting the visual pace feel artificially static, missing the subtle human rhythm that makes the live entry compelling.
